name: sign-in
props: Options in display order. OAuth ones render as 'Continue with X'; phone / email open their step. Exactly one of phone / email and no OAuth skips the welcome step.
What follows the email step: a password, a one-time email code, or a magic link + 'Check your inbox'.
Controlled / initial mode. Sign-up shows 'Create account' and a password strength meter.
The footer 'Sign up' / 'Sign in' link toggled the mode.
Step to open on mount (demos, deep links). Back still walks a sensible stack.
Prefill the number (digits; a leading dial code is stripped).
Selected dial code. +91 formats as '98765 43210' and needs 10 digits; others accept 7–15.
IN, US, GB, AE, SG, AU
Dial-code picker list (tap the chip). One entry hides the picker.
OAuth button pressed. Spinner while pending; resolve → onSuccess, throw → message shown inline.
Send an SMS code to the E.164 number ('+919876543210'). Resolve to open the code step; also used by Resend.
Called when the cells fill. Resolve → success state then onSuccess; throw → error on the cells.
Password step submitted. Resolve → onSuccess; throw → message under the field.
emailMode 'code': send the code. Resolve to open the code step.
emailMode 'code': check the code. Resolve → onSuccess.
emailMode 'magic-link': send the link. Resolve to show 'Check your inbox'.
'Send reset link' pressed on the forgot step. Resolve to show 'Check your inbox'.
Called after any successful final step (OAuth, code verified, email + password).
Shows a back button on the first step.
Make 'Terms' / 'Privacy Policy' in the legal line tappable.
Used in the default title and the logo initial.
Primary buttons, links and focus rings (black in light, white in dark by default).
Controlled error shown on the current step; onDismissError fires when the user edits or navigates.
Pressed 'Sign up' — called instead of toggling the mode.
Aliases of onEmailPassword / onOAuth; providers (apple / google) sets the OAuth part of methods when methods isn't given.
